title: Disable Vertex Percentages When Object Kind Is Zero
description: In puzzle 3D fill options: when an object kind percentage is set to 0, all vertex percentages for that kind must be disabled because anything times 0 is 0. Vertex percentage controls should be visually and interactively disabled while the object kind weight is 0.
summary: When an object-kind distribution weight is 0, vortex percentage sliders under that kind are disabled (joint contribution is always 0). Added optional WindowMeasure::Slider.disabled, emit it from puzzle3d_joint_vortex_measures, ignore setVortexKindWeight for zeroed object kinds, and wire disabled through React Slider and wgpu render_slider. Verified with zero_object_kind_weight_disables_joint_vortex_sliders and window_measure golden serialization.
